name: How do I choose the right contractor to build an ADU?
description: Select a licensed, bonded, and insured contractor experienced in full-scale additions, permitting, structural framing, and turnkey kitchen and bath remodeling.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor to build an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a licensed, insured, and bonded general contractor with direct experience in ground-up additions, structural framing, drywall, and utility coordination. Because an ADU combines whole-home structural construction with full kitchen and bathroom installations, choose a builder who handles projects from design planning through final trim work. Verify that the contractor carries both liability and workers' compensation coverage, has established familiarity with local county building departments, and provides transparent written quotes outlining scopes of work, subcontractor management, and material allowances.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a licensed, bonded, and insured contractor experienced in full-scale additions, permitting, structural framing, and turnkey kitchen and bath remodeling.
